pilot.note: design-touched; excluded from the blind arm AND from the calibration partition. Membership choice is never evidence.

dead_names.consequence: W1 ships with NO dead names in the pilot. Every cohort-level statement in this wave is therefore survivor-only and must say so; the survivorship stratification substrate (sp1500 PIT membership) is unaffected. Supplying dead names needs an operator decision on a source: extending config/delisted_symbols.yml, or admitting a close-only plane for catalog work under a fresh registration. Neither is a builder's call.
dead_names.not_done: no substitute was invented. A live name relabeled 'dead' would corrupt every survivorship read this cohort exists to enable.
dead_names.requirement: masterplan §13 / review finding 18: >=5 names that ceased trading, with terminated_reason recorded, so cohort-level statements can name who is missing

sources_checked.allowed-plane tape-end proxy (>=126 sess: ZERO candidates. The largest tape-end lag anywhere in the 2781-name universe is 32 session(s), and the names at that lag are plainly still trading — stale feeds or index-membership drops, not deaths. Treating them as dead names would be exactly the 'delisted is not stale' error the exit ledger exists to prevent, and index-exit is not death (masterplan §9.5).
sources_checked.config/delisted_symbols.yml: holds exactly 2 row(s) ['CTRA', 'TPH']; present on an allowed plane: NONE
sources_checked.data/edgar/dead_name_prices.parquet: close-only third plane — PROHIBITED for fingerprints and catalogs by the price-plane law (masterplan §9.7); not read

dead_names.status: BLOCKED — no dead name is obtainable from any allowed source

recent_ipo.rule: the baskets-plane name with the most recent first_date having >=60 and <252 sessions and no hygiene flags

secular_decliner.logged_substitution: registration §2 narrows this pick to the ceased-tape pool, which is EMPTY on the allowed planes (see dead_names). Substitution logged; nothing about the pick is evidence.
secular_decliner.rule: deepest close-to-close max drawdown over the final 1,260 sessions among names with >=1,000 sessions (damaged-cohort rule)
